study_identification_part.si_4_title: Using normative modeling to assess pharmacological treatment effect on brain state in patients with schizophrenia

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Cam-CAN (Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience) dataset with n=652 healthy controls was used to build the normative model. A single-site dataset from Peking University Sixth Hospital included 37 schizophrenia patients and 44 healthy controls for clinical application of the normative model.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Data used in the preparation of this work were obtained from the Cam-CAN repository (available at http://www.mrc-cbu.cam.ac.uk/datasets/camcan/) (Shafto et al. 2014; Taylor et al. 2017) (n=652). The Cam-CAN is a large population-based study of the healthy adult life span... Forty healthy subjects and 42 patients with schizophrenia were enrolled... For the following data analysis, 37 subjects with a mean age of 28.41 yr (SD = 8.41) were included
